VtubRust (rigrs): quick start
=============================

1. Unzip the archive into any folder and run rigrs.exe.
   Language: Settings (gear) -> General -> "Язык / Language" -> English.

2. Live2D core (Live2DCubismCore.dll):
   - if VTube Studio (Steam) is installed, rigrs finds it automatically;
   - otherwise press "Download Cubism Core from live2d.com" in the message at the top
     (official Cubism SDK, about 25 MB; you accept the Live2D licence by downloading).

3. Models: your VTube Studio models show up in the model strip (person button).
   Add your own model folders with "Add model" or put them into
   %APPDATA%\rigrs\Live2DModels.

4. Camera: Settings -> camera tab -> "Start camera", then "Calibrate" while looking
   straight at the camera. The face tracker is built in (a Rust port of OpenSeeFace,
   its files are in this folder); VTube Studio is not needed for it.
   Hand tracking and the Mediapipe tracker still use facetracker.exe from VTube Studio.
   Other trackers: NVIDIA Broadcast (RTX), iPhone / Android with the VTube Studio app.

5. Hotkeys: Settings -> clapperboard tab. A model's VTube Studio hotkeys are imported
   automatically. The globe icon makes a hotkey work while the window is not focused.

6. Twitch: Settings -> General -> Twitch settings -> type your channel name and turn on
   "Connect to chat and activate". Twitch triggers are set per hotkey (Twitch icon).
   Follows, rewards, shoutouts and ads need "Log in with Twitch" (your own Client ID
   from dev.twitch.tv, client type Public).

7. Plugins: Settings -> General -> Plugin API -> "Start API (plugins)".
   VTube Studio plugins (VBridger too) connect to ws://localhost:8001.

8. Collab: the purple buttons in the main menu. One person hosts, others join with the
   host's address and the session password.

9. OBS:
   - Spout2 (transparent background): Settings -> Camera -> "Activate Spout2",
     in OBS add a "Spout2 Capture" source (needs the Spout2 plugin for OBS);
   - or the rigrsCam virtual camera (Windows 11): "Installation help" ->
     "Open folder" -> run install.bat as administrator (once).

Hide the UI with the eye button; bring it back with Esc or a double click on an empty spot.
Mouse: left button moves, right button rotates, wheel zooms.
Items: drop an item onto the model and it sticks to that spot.

Not affiliated with VTube Studio / DenchiSoft. Live2D Cubism Core is the property of Live2D Inc.
Third-party licences: THIRD_PARTY.txt. Source code: https://github.com/tesutavt/VtubRust
